arxiv-1910-08938.title: Versatile stabilized finite element formulations for nearly and fully incompressible solid mechanics Journal: Computational Mechanics
arxiv-1910-08938.creator: Elias Karabelas, Gundolf Haase, Gernot Plank and Christoph M. Augustin
arxiv-1910-08938.description: A 2019 arXiv research paper by Elias Karabelas, Gundolf Haase, Gernot Plank and Christoph M. Augustin. Computational formulations for large strain, polyconvex, nearly incompressible elasticity have been extensively studied, but research on enhancing solution schemes that offer better tradeoffs between accuracy, robustness, and computational efficiency remains to be highly relevant.

arxiv-2101-02049.title: Estimating the carbon footprint of the GRAND Project, a multi-decade astrophysics experiment
arxiv-2101-02049.creator: Clarisse Aujoux, Kumiko Kotera, Odile Blanchard, for the GRAND Collaboration
arxiv-2101-02049.description: Abstract We present a pioneering estimate of the global yearly greenhouse gas emissions of a large-scale Astrophysics experiment over several decades: the Giant Array for Neutrino Detection (GRAND). The project aims at detecting ultra-high energy neutrinos with a 200,000 radio antenna array over 200,000 km 2 as of the 2030s.

arxiv-2104-14946.title: On the leading constant in the Manin-type conjecture for Campana points
arxiv-2104-14946.creator: Alec Shute
arxiv-2104-14946.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Alec Shute. We compare the Manin-type conjecture for Campana points recently formulated by Pieropan, Smeets, Tanimoto and Várilly-Alvarado with an alternative prediction of Browning and Van Valckenborgh in the special case of the orbifold ( ℙ 1 , D ) (\mathbb{P}^{1},D) , where D = 1 2 ​ [ 0 ] + 1 2 ​ [ 1 ] + 1 2 ​ [ ∞ ] D=\frac{1}{2}[0]+\frac{1}{2}[1]+\frac{1}{2}[\infty] .

arxiv-2106-11819.title: High Performance Optimization at the Door of the Exascale
arxiv-2106-11819.creator: Claude Tadonki
arxiv-2106-11819.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Claude Tadonki. The next frontier of high performance computing is the Exascale , and this will certainly stand as a noteworthy step in the quest for processing speed potential. In fact, we always get a fraction of the technically available computing power (so-called theoretical peak ), and the gap is likely to go hand-to-hand with the hardware complexity of the target system.

arxiv-2206-09390.title: Deterministic Finite-Memory Bias Estimation
arxiv-2206-09390.creator: Tomer Berg, Or Ordentlich, Ofer Shayevitz
arxiv-2206-09390.description: Abstract In this paper we consider the problem of estimating a Bernoulli parameter using finite memory. Let X 1 , X 2 , … X_{1},X_{2},\ldots be a sequence of independent identically distributed Bernoulli random variables with expectation θ \theta , where θ ∈ [ 0 , 1 ] \theta\in[0,1] .

arxiv-2404-09255.title: Quiver matroids Matroid morphisms, quiver Grassmannians, their Euler characteristics and 𝔽 1 {{\mathbb{F}}_{1}} -points
arxiv-2404-09255.creator: Manoel Jarra, Oliver Lorscheid, Eduardo Vital
arxiv-2404-09255.description: Abstract . In this paper, we introduce morphisms for matroids with coefficients (in the sense of Baker and Bowler) and quiver matroids. We investigate their basic properties, such as functoriality, duality, minors and cryptomorphic characterizations in terms of vectors, circuits and bases (a.k.a. Grassmann-Plücker functions).

arxiv-2404-16206.title: Knowledge Graph Completion using Structural and Textual Embeddings Thanks: Accepted in AIAI 2024 - 20th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence Applications and Innovations
arxiv-2404-16206.creator: Sakher Khalil Alqaaidi, Krzysztof Kochut
arxiv-2404-16206.description: Abstract Knowledge Graphs (KGs) are widely employed in artificial intelligence applications, such as question-answering and recommendation systems. However, KGs are frequently found to be incomplete. While much of the existing literature focuses on predicting missing nodes for given incomplete KG triples, there remains an opportunity to complete KGs by exploring relations between existing nodes, a task known as relation prediction.

arxiv-2407-08509.title: Haar Nuclear Norms with Applications to Remote Sensing Imagery Restoration
arxiv-2407-08509.creator: Shuang Xu, Chang Yu, Jiangjun Peng, Xiangyong Cao, Deyu Meng
arxiv-2407-08509.description: Abstract Remote sensing image restoration aims to reconstruct missing or corrupted areas within images. To date, low-rank based models have garnered significant interest in this field. This paper proposes a novel low-rank regularization term, named the Haar nuclear norm (HNN), for efficient and effective remote sensing image restoration.

arxiv-2409-16786.title: Hierarchy of percolation patterns in a kinetic replication model
arxiv-2409-16786.creator: Pavel Ovchinnikov, Konstantin Soldatov, Vitalii Kapitan, Gennady Y. Chitov
arxiv-2409-16786.description: Abstract The model of a one-dimensional kinetic contact process with parallel update is studied by the Monte Carlo simulations and finite-size scaling. The goal was to reveal the structure of the hidden percolative patterns (order parameters) in the active phase and the nature of transitions those patterns emerge through.

pmc-10594658.title: Carboxylate Catalysis: A Catalytic O-Silylative Aldol Reaction of Aldehydes and Ethyl Diazoacetate
pmc-10594658.creator: Saara Riuttamäki, Anton Bannykh, Petri M Pihko
pmc-10594658.description: A mild catalytic variant of the aldol reaction between ethyl diazoacetate and aldehydes is described using a combination of N,O-bis(trimethylsilyl)acetamide and catalytic tetramethylammonium pivalate as catalyst. The reaction proceeds rapidly at ambient temperature to afford the O-silylated aldol products in good to excellent yield, and the acetamide byproducts can be removed by simple filtration.

pmc-10761313.title: Review of two immunosuppressants: tacrolimus and cyclosporine
pmc-10761313.creator: HyunJong Lee, Hoon Myoung, Soung Min Kim
pmc-10761313.description: Immunosuppressants are vital in organ transplantation including facial transplantation (FT) but are associated with persistent side effects. This review article was prepared to compare the two most used immunosuppressants, cyclosporine and tacrolimus, in terms of mechanism of action, efficacy, and safety and to assess recent trials to mitigate their side effects.

pmc-11366032.title: Exploring alternative fuel solutions: lemon grass oil biodiesel blend with dibutyl ether additive for VCR diesel engines - an experimental analysis
pmc-11366032.creator: Prabhu Paramasivam, Arun Balasubramanian, Adekunle Akanni Adeleke, Peter Pelumi Ikubanni, Sandeep Kumar, Chander Prakash, Rahul Kumar
pmc-11366032.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). There has been an intense surge in interest in the search for alternative sources of petroleum fuels in the modern world as a result of the inflation of fuel prices and the historic supply gap. When compared to petroleum fuels, biodiesel is becoming an increasingly valuable option due to the fact that it produces less emissions and provides the almost same amount of energy.

pmc-13395043.creator: Lillian King, Jessica Maccarrone, Ashwinpreet Kaur, Susanna Chen, Patrick Kwan, Terence J. O'Brien, Neha Kaul
pmc-13395043.description: ObjectiveThe ketogenic diet is an established and effective treatment for drug‐resistant epilepsy and is an emerging therapy for other conditions. This study aimed to compare weekly cost of ketogenic diets with national dietary guidelines and a typical Australian diet.
